name: HIIT Timer
description: Interval timer with Tabata and other presets, big numbers you can read from the floor, countdown beeps and colours for work and rest.
prompt: A HIIT interval timer: presets like Tabata 20/10, adjustable prepare, work, rest, rounds, sets and rest between sets, a full-screen countdown that turns red for work and green for rest, beeps in the last three seconds, vibration, pause, skip and a finish screen.
author: gonzaroman
